trace.title: Mail trace
trace.sub: Find any message and see straight away whether it arrived, and if not, why.

trace.empty: No mail yet in this period. As soon as mail flows through Mailfilter it shows up here.
trace.no_results: Nothing found. Try a shorter search or a longer period.
trace.q_deleted: Blocked and deleted from quarantine by {{who}} on {{when}}.
trace.q_learned_ham: The spam filter learned this is good mail.
trace.q_learned_spam: The spam filter learned this is spam.
trace.who_sender: Who can fix it: the sender.
trace.who_recipient: Who can fix it: the recipient or their mail provider.
trace.who_us: Who can fix it: the Mailfilter administrator.
trace.who_nobody: Usually solves itself: Mailfilter keeps trying.
trace.verdict_delivered: Every recipient's mail server accepted the message.
trace.verdict_queued: Mailfilter is still processing this message.
trace.verdict_deferred: Mailfilter keeps trying for up to 5 days.
trace.verdict_quarantined: Held because it looks like spam or is dangerous. Release it if it is good mail.

quarantine.title: Quarantine
quarantine.sub: Mail that looks like spam or is dangerous is held here. Release what is good, block what is not; the spam filter learns from every choice.
quarantine.empty: Quarantine is empty. Nothing is waiting for you.
quarantine.teach_hint: Releasing teaches "this is good mail", blocking teaches "this is spam".
quarantine.released: Released; the message is being delivered.
quarantine.learned: The spam filter learned from it.
quarantine.content_hint: Shown as plain text: links and images are not loaded, so viewing is safe.
quarantine.virus_warning: This message contains a virus. Only an administrator can release it.
quarantine.virus_warning_admin: This message contains a virus. Only release it if you are sure it is a false alarm.
quarantine.queue_unavailable: Mailfilter cannot reach the mail queue right now, so this list may include messages that were already handled.

backups.title: Backups
backups.sub: Local backups of all settings, DKIM keys, certificates, quarantine, the database and the spam filter's learning data.
backups.empty: No backups yet. The first one is made tonight, or press Full backup now.
backups.verify: Check that the backup is complete
backups.delete: Delete this full backup and its incrementals
backups.delete_confirm: Delete the full backup of {{when}} and all incremental backups that build on it?
backups.nightly_d: Every night; a full backup every {{days}} days, incremental in between.
backups.keep_d: Older ones are removed together with their incrementals.
backups.comp_files_d: settings, lists, passwords, DKIM keys, certificates, quarantined mail
backups.remote_later: Copying backups to FTP, FTPS or SCP comes in a later version.
backups.restore_warn: Restoring replaces the current settings and data with those from this backup. Mail services stop for a moment; incoming mail waits at the sender and is delivered afterwards.
backups.restore_chain_one: This incremental backup builds on the full backup and 1 earlier step; all are replayed in order.
backups.restore_chain_other: This incremental backup builds on the full backup and {{count}} earlier steps; all are replayed in order.
backups.safety: Make a safety backup of the current state first (recommended)

smtp.title: E-mail sending
smtp.sub: How Mailfilter sends its own messages: alerts, quarantine reports, password notices and backup reports.
smtp.mode_local_d: Uses the gateway's own Postfix. Messages are DKIM-signed like all other mail. Recommended.
smtp.mode_smtp_d: For example Microsoft 365, Google Workspace or your own mail server.
smtp.username_d: Leave empty if the server does not need a login.
smtp.password_keep: A password is saved. Leave empty to keep it.
smtp.insecure: Without encryption or certificate check, passwords and mail can be read or changed on the way.
smtp.test_d: Uses the settings in the form, also before saving.
smtp.modern_tls: TLS 1.2 or newer, with certificate checks, through STARTTLS or direct TLS
smtp.modern_auth: SMTP AUTH; the password is stored encrypted
smtp.modern_headers: Date, Message-ID and Auto-Submitted headers, so autoresponders do not reply
smtp.modern_local: Default route through the gateway itself, with DKIM signing
